notes.title: DevLog #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080744/c52e032d2c47aa939b96896b998a287e0b7113f9.png[/img]

Rapta is undergoing significant changes! We are developing a more immersive experience and implementing additional content. Focusing on what we already have, our main goal is to improve, adapt, and add new features that enhance the current content.

[h3][b]* ALL IMAGES SHOWN ARE RELATED TO DEVELOPMENT AND DO NOT REPRESENT THE FINAL GAME *[/b][/h3]

[h2][list]
[*] New Environment
[/list][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080744/cd027ed71e8942031a07cf86b210bc7e8650f974.gif[/img]

Notable changes include a fresh environment with interactive elements, such as the telephone. This new setting will also allow us to expand on our investigative storyline.

[h2][list]
[*] Bug Bounty
[/list][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080744/cdb346f37cedb22747c5a419dbb5d06e0b61745e.gif[/img]

Bug bounty rewards will now be separate from conventional hacks. In the Bug Bounty menu, you’ll find companies willing to pay for specific services. Details include difficulty, reward, and the reputation required to perform the task.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080744/d85765f9fc2c19a53da48a17537822dbaa6401f3.gif[/img]

The minigame for completing a Bug Bounty task involves identifying cable faults and connecting only the correct wires. This, along with other minigames, adapts based on difficulty.

[h2][list]
[*] Searching Target
[/list][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080744/3e06b1bc7ca7c2baa1312783b816ac57ca73f8d3.gif[/img]

Finding a target is now a minigame. These adaptive minigames cannot fail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080744/811c0d60a4100a7e0162f77457d3c998bf30a3ae.gif[/img]

[h2][list]
[*] Hacking
[/list][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080744/fe396360943b2b9fe4a361afce6c9f6ac81f380f.gif[/img]

The password minigame, previously part of the heist process, will now be relocated as one of the hacking minigames. These minigames also adapt to the situation.

[h2][list]
[*] Mais 
[/list][/h2]
[list]
[*] More minigames will be added during hacking.
[*] After hacking the target, you’ll have another minigame to steal as much money as possible.
[*] The timer will shift from the computer screen to the desk as an interactive object.
[*] Upgrades will directly impact minigame adaptability.
[*] The environment will change dynamically based on events.
[*] Each ending will be accompanied by a transition animation for added immersion.
[*] Each ending will receive a visual rework
[/list]

[h2][list]
[*] Update Release
[/list][/h2]
While there’s still much work to be done before the update, we estimate it will arrive around November.

notes.title: Rapta is out on Early Access!
notes.content:
Explore the Silicon Sneak system and use your efforts to rescue your kidnapped sister or uncover the hidden secrets within the system. Your decisions matter and can lead to various endings, but be cautious—the clock is ticking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080744/1f8836c6054e88bf2bbbd05d9a398165e21ba5d3.png[/img]
Test the Rapta beta now, fully stylized in Pixel art with customizable colors. Explore all the unique endings and the secrets hidden by Silicon Sneak. Currently

Rapta features 6 unique endings, 15 achievements, and various minigames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080744/b6f9c9b1f143103629aa2f035d0e19152dfdb15c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed the timer not starting if the connection drops.
[*] Addressed other minor bugs.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080744/f4203324293ca22b8edbcce9f3e77f664aef896c.png[/img]
The current version of Rapta was developed based on an idea, and after seeing the results, some changes need to be made both in gameplay and appearance.

[list]
[h3][*]New Perspective[/h3]
[/list]
Rapta will gain a new perspective beyond the computer, showing a glimpse of the room, with the environment adapting according to situations and interactive objects.

[list]
[h3][*]- Minigames + Interaction[/h3]
[/list]
The minigames will undergo changes, some being relocated and others removed, making room for more interactive events and enhancing exploration immersion.

[list]
[h3][*]Demo Version[/h3]
[/list]
After the updates for the new version of Rapta, the current beta version will be released as a demo.
